module: Small routing module for the SUMO import (.nod.xml / .edg.xml files) into Road Architect. It contains no logic: it re-exports the networkImport.importSumoFromFile function under two names. The Road Network Import/Exporter window calls it via require('editor/roadArchitect/sumoImport').importFromFile(filePath, options).
notes: importFromFile and importFromPrefix point to the same function (networkImport.importSumoFromFile); importFromPrefix therefore has no behavior of its own.
The module is loaded with require() by roadNetworkExporter, not as an extension.

importFromFile.desc: Alias of networkImport.importSumoFromFile: imports a SUMO network from a file (actual signature in editor/roadArchitect/networkImport; roadNetworkExporter calls it with (filePath, options)).
